decisions.reason: The accepted referral-reward logic and reported NFT-attribute mismatch do not change the book cover's placement, cropping, visibility, or size.
The candidate already has a complete message-688 MODIFY reflecting four tickets and a $35 commission for coded referrals and six tickets and a $12 commission for no-code mints.
The existing message-688 MODIFY already updates the relevant FAQ reward explanations for both coded-referral and no-code flows.
Message 688 does not change email delivery, notification channels, or transactional email contents.
The confirmed referral-reward logic and metadata discrepancy do not change the email authentication method or dashboard-access workflow.
The candidate already contains a message-688 MODIFY setting the coded-referral commission to $35, followed by RESUME; no additional update or removal is required.
Message 688 does not alter the current or planned product name.
The source confirms referral ticket and commission allocations but does not change the Small Block winner count, prize amount, draw trigger, eligibility, or pool allocation.
The existing message-688 MODIFY already sets four tickets per coded referral and removes the obsolete accepted-referral entry attribute.
Message 688 reports stale NFT attributes rather than changing the accuracy requirement, and the concrete failure is already represented by a message-688 RUNTIME_FAILURE.
The source does not address NFT transfers, ownership changes, or which NFT-linked state follows a transferred asset.
The accepted referral allocations and NFT-attribute mismatch do not change automatic prize payout or introduce a claim control.
